name: catalogue-quarters
description: Museum catalogues that read 'early' and 'late' as the first and last quarter of a century (early 20th century = 1900-1924, late = 1975-1999), 'mid' as the middle fifth (1940-1959), and 'early 1790s' as 1790-1792, 'mid 1790s' as 1794-1796; the conventions of jeresig/node-yearrange.
